title: Data products
explain: Contract, owner, quality, consumers. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Data products" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Data products, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Data products without a failure story
howToApply: Use Data products explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: PRODUCT not DUMP: Owner + contract + quality — not a pile of tables.
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Data products” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Data products” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Finance and Sales disagree on “revenue” — Data products forces one productized definition.
